personality.description: This person tends to stick to familiar routines, prefers proven methods, and feels uneasy when asked to embrace unfamiliar ideas. They are highly organized and meticulous, often planning ahead, checking details carefully, and keeping close track of responsibilities. In moral dilemmas, they usually try to protect harmony and avoid hurting anyone, but high anxiety can make them overthink the situation, worry about making the wrong choice, and seek reassurance before deciding. In group discussions, they speak openly and energetically, yet remain tactful and supportive, often smoothing tension and encouraging agreement while also getting visibly stressed if conflict escalates.
